title: A Randomised Controlled Trial of Iodide Supplementation in Preterm Infants Follow-up at 2 Years
brief_summary: The purpose of this trial is to determine whether iodide supplementation of neonates born under 31 weeks gestation improves neurodevelopment measured at two years of age.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All infants born under 31 weeks gestation

Exclusion Criteria:

* Mother exposed to excess iodine during pregnancy or delivery
